description: Source code for network packet filtering rules and logic in Zephyr OS, including rule management, evaluation, and specific packet tests.

methods.name: get_ip_rules
methods.description: Returns the appropriate IP rules list based on the protocol family (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: apply_tests
methods.description: Applies all tests in a rule to a network packet; returns true if all pass.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates rules against a packet, returning verdict based on first matching rule.

methods.name: lock_evaluate
methods.description: Locks the rule list, evaluates rules, then unlocks.

methods.name: net_pkt_filter_send_ok
methods.description: Checks if sending a packet is permitted based on rules.

methods.name: net_pkt_filter_recv_ok
methods.description: Checks if receiving a packet is permitted based on rules.

methods.name: net_pkt_filter_local_in_recv_ok
methods.description: Checks if local input reception of a packet is permitted, if local_in_recv_rules are enabled.

methods.name: net_pkt_filter_ip_recv_ok
methods.description: Checks if IP packet reception is permitted for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: npf_insert_rule
methods.description: Inserts a rule at the beginning of a rule list.

methods.name: npf_append_rule
methods.description: Appends a rule at the end of a rule list.

methods.name: npf_remove_rule
methods.description: Removes a specific rule from a rule list.

methods.name: npf_remove_all_rules
methods.description: Removes all rules from a rule list.
